name: Bootlegger
look: a sneaky raccoon kit with a bandit mask, a flat cap, a ringed tail and a ceramic jug on its back
entry: A little smuggler that hauls a stolen jug through the woods at dusk. If it is caught, it plays dead until whoever caught it looks away, then bolts with whatever it can carry.
how: Wild: common, at night, in the Liquor Meadows (an overworld biome added by CobbleEffort: Kanto 0.8.0).
It learns Contraband Swap at level 22.
Evolves into Moonshiner at level 34 at night.
